tests/krusgraph_checks/fct_custledgerent:
-- From Krusgraph's amount check (validate_plan, amount_levels): CustLedgerEntry-21.SalesLCY-18 is an amount of the whole CustLedgerEntry-21 row, repeated on every DetailedCustLedgEntry-379 row in a join (DetailedCustLedgEntry-379.$Company+CustLedgerEntryNo-2 -> CustLedgerEntry-21.$Company+EntryNo-1, rule SAP pack); lines per header not counted.
-- fct_custledgerentry_21 has one row per CustLedgerEntry-21 row. Returns the two sums of sales_lcy_18 when the mart's differs from CustLedgerEntry-21's own; passes when it returns none.
-- A mart that joins the lines and carries sales_lcy_18 on each of them sums it once per line, and its total comes out larger.
select m.[total] as [mart_total], h.[total] as [custledgerentry_21_total]
from (select sum(cast([sales_lcy_18] as decimal(38, 4))) as [total] from {{ ref('fct_custledgerentry_21') }}) as m
cross join (select sum(cast([sales_lcy_18] as decimal(38, 4))) as [total] from {{ ref('stg_dynamics__custledgerentry_21') }}) as h
where abs(coalesce(m.[total], 0) - coalesce(h.[total], 0)) >= 0.01

-- fct_detailedcustledgentry_379 has one row per DetailedCustLedgEntry-379 row and leaves CustLedgerEntry-21.SalesLCY-18 out: a header amount cannot be summed over lines generically there, so this tests the grain instead.
-- Returns the two row counts when the mart has a different number of rows than DetailedCustLedgEntry-379; passes when it returns none.
-- A join that multiplies the lines (or a header amount added at this grain, joined over more rows) shows here.
select m.[rows] as [mart_rows], s.[rows] as [detailedcustledgentry_379_rows]
from (select count(*) as [rows] from {{ ref('fct_detailedcustledgentry_379') }}) as m
cross join (select count(*) as [rows] from {{ ref('stg_dynamics__detailedcustledgentry_379') }}) as s
where m.[rows] <> s.[rows]

-- From Krusgraph's amount check (validate_plan, amount_levels): salesorder.totalamount is an amount of the whole salesorder row, repeated on every invoice row in a join (invoice.salesorderid -> salesorder.salesorderid, rule SAP pack); lines per header not counted.
-- Pack rule: dynamics365 trap dv_doubled_totals (Header totals and line amounts are the same money).
-- From Krusgraph's amount check (validate_plan, amount_levels): salesorder.totalamount_base is an amount of the whole salesorder row, repeated on every invoice row in a join (invoice.salesorderid -> salesorder.salesorderid, rule SAP pack); lines per header not counted.
-- From Krusgraph's amount check (validate_plan, amount_levels): opportunity.estimatedvalue is an amount of the whole opportunity row, repeated on every invoice row in a join (invoice.opportunityid -> opportunity.opportunityid, rule SAP pack); lines per header not counted.
-- From Krusgraph's amount check (validate_plan, amount_levels): opportunity.totalamount is an amount of the whole opportunity row, repeated on every invoice row in a join (invoice.opportunityid -> opportunity.opportunityid, rule SAP pack); lines per header not counted.
-- fct_invoice has one row per invoice row and leaves salesorder.totallineitemamount, salesorder.totalamount, salesorder.totalamount_base, opportunity.estimatedvalue, opportunity.totalamount out: a header amount cannot be summed over lines generically there, so this tests the grain instead.
-- Returns the two row counts when the mart has a different number of rows than invoice; passes when it returns none.
-- A join that multiplies the lines (or a header amount added at this grain, joined over more rows) shows here.
select m.[rows] as [mart_rows], s.[rows] as [invoice_rows]
from (select count(*) as [rows] from {{ ref('fct_invoice') }}) as m
cross join (select count(*) as [rows] from {{ ref('stg_dynamics__invoice') }}) as s
where m.[rows] <> s.[rows]
tests/krusgraph_checks/fct_invoice__tota:
-- From Krusgraph's amount check (validate_plan, amount_levels): invoice.totalamount is an amount of the whole invoice row, repeated on every invoicedetail row in a join (invoicedetail.invoiceid -> invoice.invoiceid, rule SAP pack); lines per header not counted.
-- Pack rule: dynamics365 trap dv_doubled_totals (Header totals and line amounts are the same money).
-- fct_invoice has one row per invoice row. Returns the two sums of totalamount when the mart's differs from invoice's own; passes when it returns none.
-- A mart that joins the lines and carries totalamount on each of them sums it once per line, and its total comes out larger.
select m.[total] as [mart_total], h.[total] as [invoice_total]
from (select sum(cast([totalamount] as decimal(38, 4))) as [total] from {{ ref('fct_invoice') }}) as m
cross join (select sum(cast([totalamount] as decimal(38, 4))) as [total] from {{ ref('stg_dynamics__invoice') }}) as h
where abs(coalesce(m.[total], 0) - coalesce(h.[total], 0)) >= 0.01
